description: This Java source file defines the 'SudoStreamPids' class, a final immutable command object used within the Eclipse Ditto framework for managing streaming operations related to persistence IDs and their snapshot revisions. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and managing command properties such as burst size, timeout, and lower bound for stream resumption.

classes.name: SudoStreamPids
classes.description: Immutable command class for starting a stream of persistence IDs with snapshot revisions, supporting JSON serialization, header management, and stream control parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SudoStreamPids with specified burst, timeout, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into a SudoStreamPids command.

methods.name: withLowerBound
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current command with a specified lower bound for stream resumption.

methods.name: getLowerBound
methods.description: Retrieves the current lower bound PID.

methods.name: hasNonEmptyLowerBound
methods.description: Checks if the lower bound is set to a non-dummy value.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Returns the burst size parameter for stream collection.

methods.name: getTimeoutMillis
methods.description: Returns the timeout in milliseconds parameter.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends command payload fields to a JSON builder according to schema version.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the command type prefix string.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category, which is QUERY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
